verdicts.decision_note: The client requests a task-local pass restyling all three character assets with a raw graffiti aesthetic and delivering the results.
The client adds concrete rendered-style criteria for the character assets: darker, rougher, more energetic sketching, and more attitude.
The freelancer explicitly raises a material uncertainty about whether the restyle applies to one character or all three.
The client specifies one three-character style-alteration attempt and adds recreation of the existing frames to the requested artifact work; the funding language is not encoded.
The client resolves the character-count uncertainty by explicitly confirming that the alteration applies to all three characters.
The client withdraws the freelancer's restyle-and-frame-recreation task by stating that the client will perform it independently.
